== Reward == {{Gear Set |Champion's Crown |Champion's Breastplate |Champion's Vambraces |Champion's Bracer |Champion's Gauntlets |Champion's Greaves |Champion's Boots }} == Checklist == Turn-ins to [[Captain Njall]] in [[Thurgadin]].{{CheckboxList}} *[[Champion's Crown]] :*[[Corroded Plate Helmet]] :*3x [[Crushed Coral]] *[[Champion's Breastplate]] :*[[Corroded Breastplate]] :*3x [[Flawless Diamond]] *[[Champion's Vambraces]] :*[[Corroded Plate Vambraces]] :*3x [[Flawed Emerald]] *[[Champion's Bracer]] :*[[Corroded Plate Bracer]] :*3x [[Crushed Flame Emerald]] *[[Champion's Gauntlets]] :*[[Corroded Plate Gauntlets]] :*3x [[Crushed Topaz]] *[[Champion's Greaves]] :*[[Corroded Plate Greaves]] :*3x [[Flawed Sea Sapphire]] *[[Champion's Boots]] :*[[Corroded Plate Boots]] :*3x [[Crushed Black Marble]] {{End}} == Walkthrough == ''Intro dialogue needed.'' Captain Njall says, 'Well met, Ogre! I am Captain Njall, commander of the city gaurds here in Thurgadin. If ye seek ta join our ranks, I welcome ye with open arms and have an offer to make if you are interested. If ye seek to be our enemy, I hope ye can run swifter than my archers arrows.' (*yeah, guards is misspelled in game*) You say, "I am interested" Captain Njall says, 'Aye, I thought ye might be. My elite warriors are in sore need of some enchanted armor. Unfortunately, I can't spare the men to go out and fetch me the components. If you can do this for me, I'll gladly reward you with a piece of it. I need materials for a helm, a breastplate, armplates, bracers, gauntlets, greaves, and boots.' '''After turn-in:''' Captain Njall smiles warmly as he hands you your reward. 'You have done well, _____.'
* Your faction standing with [[Coldain]] got better. * Your faction standing with [[Dain Frostreaver IV]] got better. * Your faction standing with [[Kromzek]] got worse. * Your faction standing with [[Kromrif]] got worse.
{{YouGainExperience}} == Helm == You say, "What helm" Captain Njall says, 'To create a piece of armor to protect your skull I will require three pieces of [[Crushed Coral]] as well as a [[Corroded Plate Helmet]].' == Breastplate == You say, "What breastplate" Captain Njall says, 'For the breastplate, I will need a [[Corroded Breastplate]] and three [[Flawless Diamond]]s. Once I have them in my possession it will not take long to craft a sturdy breastplate.' == Sleeves == You say, "What armplates" Captain Njall says, 'Protection for your arms will come at the price of a set of [[Corroded Plate Vambraces]] and three [[Flawed Emerald]]s.' == Bracer == You say, "What bracers" Captain Njall says, 'For the bracers, I will require a [[Corroded Plate Bracer]] and a set of three [[Crushed Flame Emerald]]s. Return to me if you happen to find these things in your travels.' == Gauntlets == You say, "What gauntlets" Captain Njall says, 'Protecting your hands is very important. I can forge protection for your hands if you bring me a pair of [[Corroded Plate Gauntlets]] and three [[Crushed Topaz]].' == Leggings == You say, "What greaves" Captain Njall says, 'A set of [[Corroded Plate Greaves]] might be salvageable if you were to find three [[Flawed Sea Sapphire]]s. With the right techniques almost anything is possible.' == Boots == You say, "What boots" Captain Njall says, 'Boots made for battle are not always the most comfortable available. However if you seek a fine set for battle bring me a set of [[Corroded Plate Boots]] and three pieces of [[Crushed Black Marble]].'
